# Kwai for Business
> Advertising platform for creating, managing, and optimizing campaigns across Kwai’s apps and audiences.

Kwai for Business provides advertiser-facing resources for account setup, campaign operations, creative guidance, policies, and support for running ads on the Kwai ecosystem.

## Main Site
- [Kwai for Business Home](https://www.kwaipros.com/): Main entry point for advertisers, products, and platform information.
- [Advertise on Kwai](https://www.kwaipros.com/advertise): Overview of advertising opportunities, formats, and platform value.
- [Business Help Center](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center): Central support hub for advertiser questions and operational guidance.
- [Contact Us](https://www.kwaipros.com/contact-us): Contact options for sales, support, and business inquiries.
- [About Kwai for Business](https://www.kwaipros.com/about-us): Company and platform background for advertisers and partners.

## Getting Started
- [Create an Account](https://www.kwaipros.com/sign-up): Account registration entry for new advertisers.
- [Log In](https://www.kwaipros.com/login): Sign-in page for existing advertiser accounts.
- [Get Started Guide](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/get-started): Introductory guidance for launching advertising on the platform.
- [Account Setup](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/account-setup): Steps and requirements for configuring an advertiser account.
- [Business Verification](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/business-verification): Information about verification requirements and approval processes.

## Advertising Solutions
- [Ad Solutions](https://www.kwaipros.com/solutions): Overview of campaign objectives, placements, and advertiser use cases.
- [App Promotion](https://www.kwaipros.com/solutions/app-promotion): Guidance for driving app installs and in-app actions.
- [E-commerce Solutions](https://www.kwaipros.com/solutions/ecommerce): Advertising options for online retail and product sales.
- [Lead Generation](https://www.kwaipros.com/solutions/lead-generation): Campaign approaches for collecting leads and customer inquiries.
- [Brand Awareness](https://www.kwaipros.com/solutions/brand-awareness): Solutions focused on reach, visibility, and audience awareness.

## Ad Formats and Creative
- [Ad Formats](https://www.kwaipros.com/ad-formats): Overview of supported ad types and placements.
- [In-Feed Ads](https://www.kwaipros.com/ad-formats/in-feed-ads): Native feed placement format for scalable campaign delivery.
- [Video Ads](https://www.kwaipros.com/ad-formats/video-ads): Video-based creative format guidance and usage details.
- [Creative Center](https://www.kwaipros.com/creative-center): Resources for developing effective ad creatives and assets.
- [Creative Best Practices](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/creative-best-practices): Recommendations for compliant, high-performing ad creative.

## Campaign Management
- [Campaign Creation](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/campaign-creation): Instructions for building campaigns, ad groups, and ads.
- [Targeting](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/targeting): Audience targeting options and setup guidance.
- [Budget and Bidding](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/budget-bidding): Explanation of budgets, bids, and delivery controls.
- [Optimization](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/optimization): Tips for improving campaign performance and efficiency.
- [Reporting](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/reporting): Guidance on metrics, dashboards, and campaign analysis.

## Measurement and Tracking
- [Pixel Setup](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/pixel-setup): Instructions for installing and configuring conversion tracking.
- [App Event Tracking](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/app-event-tracking): Setup guidance for measuring app events and conversions.
- [Attribution](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/attribution): Information about attribution logic and conversion measurement.
- [Conversion Tracking](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/conversion-tracking): Overview of tracking methods for campaign outcomes.
- [Data and Analytics](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/data-analytics): Reporting and analytics guidance for advertiser performance review.

## Policies and Compliance
- [Advertising Policies](https://www.kwaipros.com/policies): Central index of advertising rules and restrictions.
- [Ad Review Policy](https://www.kwaipros.com/policies/ad-review): Standards and process for ad approval review.
- [Prohibited Content](https://www.kwaipros.com/policies/prohibited-content): Content categories and practices not allowed in ads.
- [Restricted Industries](https://www.kwaipros.com/policies/restricted-industries): Rules for regulated or limited advertising categories.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.kwaipros.com/policies/community-guidelines): Platform conduct and content expectations relevant to advertisers.

## Billing and Payments
- [Billing Help](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/billing): Support articles for charges, invoices, and payment issues.
- [Payment Methods](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/payment-methods): Supported payment options and setup instructions.
- [Invoices](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/invoices): Guidance for accessing and understanding billing invoices.
- [Account Balance](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/account-balance): Information about balances, top-ups, and spending status.
- [Refunds and Adjustments](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/refunds-adjustments): Policies and processes for billing corrections and refunds.

## Support and Resources
- [Help Center Home](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center): Searchable support center for advertiser documentation.
- [FAQ](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/faq): Frequently asked questions about accounts, ads, and billing.
- [Submit a Request](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/submit-request): Support request form for platform and account issues.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.kwaipros.com/help-center/troubleshooting): Common issue resolution steps for advertisers.
- [Announcements](https://www.kwaipros.com/news): Product updates, notices, and platform announcements.
